'''December 2001 Melbourne tournament (16 December)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Melbourne, Australia on 16 December 2001. [[Rodney Lee]] won it. It is known from Luca Costanzo's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3200">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-19-melbourne-oz-16-12-01-to-the-izzod3200/ melbourne-oz-16-12-01-to-the-izzo], DeckTech (Luca "Luca/Tzizvvt" Costanzo, 19 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-19-melbourne-oz-16-12-01-to-the-izzod3200/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 December 2001
* '''Site:''' Melbourne, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Rodney Lee]]
